fr_html: Le PRESIDENT répond que les cas visés par lui sont ceux où il y a des engagements contractuels, mais que de tels engagements peuvent être multiformes.
en_html: The PRESIDENT answered that the cases he included were those in which contractual agreement existed, but that such agreements might be in many forms.
